Description Conﬁgure the NvM stack for this ECU. In the methodology library this is modeled as a single task (for simplicity) though in practice it may consist of several single tasks. Requirements for the conﬁguration of NvM can be collected • from the upstream information about ServiceDependencies and ServiceNeeds in the ECU Extract and BSW Modules • from existing ECU conﬁguration values • from Service Component Descriptions created for other Services (e.g. DEM) Relation Type Related Element Mul. Note Performer ECU Integrator 1 Consumes ECU Extract 1 Application software requirements for NvM, especially SwcServiceDependency and ServiceNeeds.
